response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_records, conservation_records * 1.0 / SUM(conservation_records) OVER () AS fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, insurstat IS NULL LIMIT 10
